articles.title: Could a Former Batman Actor Become the Joker? Fans Think So!
articles.summary: Imagine Batman and Joker swapping roles! In the new 'Absolute Batman' comic, Joker is the rich guy and Batman is the troublemaker. Fans want a past Batman actor to voice this twisted Joker—like Christian Bale, who played a creepy businessman in 'American Psycho.'

articles.title: Sinner's Scary Slip and a Bloody Shoe: How He Won His Wild Wimbledon Match
articles.summary: Tennis star Jannik Sinner almost lost his first Wimbledon match! He slipped, fell, and even had blood seeping from his shoe. But he fought back from two sets down to win in a five-set thriller that lasted over three hours.

articles.title: Six British Players Crash Out on Wimbledon's First Day—Including a Big Upset!
articles.summary: It was a rough start for British tennis at Wimbledon. Cameron Norrie, a former semifinalist, lost a five-set heartbreaker to qualifier Michael Zheng. Five other Brits also lost, and Jack Draper pulled out with an injury before even playing.
